dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Furuya Noboru's intel is actually pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: About him... if it weren't for me pushing hard on the issues about the Sakoku Decree, I wouldn't even have realized that he was a senior member of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: But while he seems to be weak and unfit, he is actually a very seasoned adventurer. I've heard that many adventurers in the guild go to him for advice.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: He is not a bad fellow. But if only he could help me get out of Inazuma...
